therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with ISN/RPS 2003 Class III or IV lupus nephritis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with complete renal response (CRR) at Week 76

results.effect_size: Adjusted difference in CRR rate: 13.40% (95% CI: 1.95–24.84); obinutuzumab 46.4% vs placebo 33.1%
results.target_engagement_evidence: CD19 B-cell depletion monitored; anti-dsDNA titer reduction significantly greater with obinutuzumab (adjusted mean difference -0.36 log IU/mL, p=0.0006); complement C3 increase significantly greater with obinutuzumab (adjusted mean difference 0.14 g/L, p<0.0001)
biomarker_changes: Anti-dsDNA titer: obinutuzumab -0.38 log IU/mL vs placebo -0.01 log IU/mL at Week 50 (adjusted difference -0.36, p=0.0006)
Complement C3: obinutuzumab +0.20 g/L vs placebo +0.06 g/L at Week 50 (adjusted difference +0.14, p<0.0001)
eGFR change: obinutuzumab +2.31 vs placebo -1.54 mL/min/1.73m² at Week 76 (adjusted difference 3.84, p=0.1842)
SLEDAI-2K change: obinutuzumab -5.63 vs placebo -5.51 at Week 76 (adjusted difference -0.12, p=0.9384)
subgroup_findings: CRR with successful prednisone taper at Week 76: obinutuzumab 42.7% vs placebo 30.9% (adjusted difference 11.88%, p=0.0421)
Proteinuric response at Week 76: obinutuzumab 55.5% vs placebo 41.9% (adjusted difference 13.68%, p=0.0227)
Death or renal-related events: obinutuzumab 18.9% vs placebo 35.6% (adjusted difference -16.83%, p=0.0026)
Overall renal response at Week 50: obinutuzumab 59.1% vs placebo 50.7% (adjusted difference 8.36%, p=0.1670)
CRR with serum creatinine criteria at Week 76: obinutuzumab 46.4% vs placebo 33.1% (adjusted difference 13.37%, p=0.0237)
safety_signals: No hepatitis B reactivation, PML, gastrointestinal perforations, or Hy's Law events in either arm
Worsening of pre-existing cardiac conditions: 0 obinutuzumab vs 2 placebo
Serious neutropenia: 4 obinutuzumab; febrile neutropenia: 1 obinutuzumab

dose_info.dose: 1000 mg (obinutuzumab); 2.0–2.5 g/day (MMF); 0.5 mg/kg/day max 60 mg/day (prednisone); 80 mg IV (methylprednisolone premedication)
dose_info.schedule: Obinutuzumab IV at Baseline, Weeks 2, 24, 26, 50, 52, then from Week 80 every 6 months; MMF divided doses through Week 80; prednisone tapered to 5 mg/day by Day 15 through Week 80

context.indication: ISN/RPS 2003 Class III or IV lupus nephritis
context.duration: 76 weeks (primary endpoint); up to approximately 11 years (long-term follow-up)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Obinutuzumab depletes autoreactive B cells, reducing the autoantibody-driven renal inflammation that MMF alone incompletely suppresses, thereby amplifying the overall immunosuppressive effect on lupus nephritis biology.
modulation_entries.citation: Adjusted Difference = 13.40 (95% CI: 1.95–24.84), p = 0.0232; obinutuzumab 46.4% vs placebo 33.1% CRR at Week 76

modulation_entries.hypothesis: MMF suppresses T-cell and residual B-cell proliferation, providing a complementary immunosuppressive environment that supports the sustained B-cell depletion achieved by obinutuzumab and reduces autoantibody-mediated renal injury.
modulation_entries.citation: Anti-dsDNA titer reduction significantly greater with obinutuzumab (adjusted mean difference -0.36 log IU/mL, p=0.0006); complement C3 increase significantly greater with obinutuzumab (adjusted mean difference 0.14 g/L, p<0.0001)
